headline: Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas, Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas, White & Case act on Urban Company ₹2,500 crore QIP
sum: Urban Company Limited has raised ₹2,500 crore from a Qualified Institutions Placement of equity shares. Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co advised Urban Company on this QIP.
detail: Urban Company Limited has raised ₹2,500 crore from a Qualified Institutions Placement of equity shares. Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co advised Urban Company on this QIP. The transaction team consisted of Prashant Gupta (Partner and National Practice Head – Capital Markets), Ruth Chenchiah (Partner), Romit Raja Srivastava (Principal Associate), Associates Bhoomika Gupta and Arjan Singh Pental. Prashant Gupta, Ruth Chenchiah Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas and White & Case served as the Indian legal counsel and the international legal counsel for the book running lead managers, respectively.
